args.action_description: FRAME FORMAT: identical even canvas, constant physical pivot, fixed whole-body scale and exact source palette. Preserve original character, helmet, armor, body height and rigid weapon dimensions in every frame. Keep the existing LOW TOP-DOWN view and existing direction. North aims up away from viewer, south down, east right, west left. Never switch to front pseudo3D or a different camera. Full body visible with transparent margins. As a humanoid alien soldier with the existing gun, raise gun along facing and fire three discrete acid energy pulses with brief attached flashes and small full-body recoil, then return ready. Do not transform to ball during this clip. Fixed rigid gun, no morphing.
